description: causal claim: 用 "we demonstrate / we show / we identify"; 强结果用过去式 direct claim
associative claim: 用 "consistent with / in line with / supports / suggests"; 不强行归因
speculative claim: 用 "may / could / might / possibly / prompts us to speculate"; 用 modal + 模糊主语
gap statement: 用 "remains elusive / unclear / poorly understood / largely unexplored"; 不是 "nobody knows"
abstract 必含 "Here we ..." 或 "Here, by/in/using ..., we ..." 一句，明示本文工作
abstract 末尾必含 "Our study/data/findings provide(s) ..." 或 "Together, our findings reveal ..." 总结性 claim
results 段每段一个 lead claim 句（"We find / show / identify / demonstrate ..."），然后 evidence
discussion 用 "Our findings suggest/imply/indicate"；不要重复 abstract 里的 "demonstrate"
每个非平凡 claim 挂 figure/data citation（Fig. X, Extended Data Fig. X, Table X）
citation 紧跟被引概念之后，不移到句末
intro paragraph 1：领域最宽背景（1-2 句）+ 关键概念定义（1-2 句）+ 现状综述（2-3 句）
intro paragraph 2-3：现有方法局限 / 知识 gap / 未解问题
intro paragraph 末 / 开新段：本文工作 + 总体方法 + 总体发现预告
discussion：先重申 lead finding（不带新数据），再 mechanistically interpret，再 limitation，再 implication
第一人称复数 "we" 主导，避免 "the authors"、单数 "I"、passive 过度
hedged over-claim 黑名单：避免 "obviously / clearly / undoubtedly / certainly / of course"
Nature 不使用感叹号，不使用引号强调（避免 "novel" "first" "groundbreaking" 出现过多）
intro 段引用密度高（每句 1-3 个上标），results/discussion 引用密度下降（自己数据为主）
引用组格式：连续引用用连字符 "1–5"，非连续用逗号 "1,3,5"
避免长句堆叠（>50 词一句话）；用 period 而非 comma + clause 链
topic sentence 优先：每段第一句给出该段 lead 主张；细节证据在后
parallel structure：并列成分用相同语法形式
10 以下数字拼写（"three mutants"），10 及以上用数字（"152 streams"）；Nature 例外：figure/table 里全数字
百分号紧贴数字："52%" not "52 percent"；单位前空格："5 °C" not "5°C"（Nature 例外）
基因/蛋白写法：人基因全大写斜体（HES1），蛋白首字母大写正体（Hes1）；小鼠全小写斜体（Hes1）
拉丁学名斜体：Homo sapiens, Escherichia coli（属名大写、种名小写、整体斜体）
use abbreviation 时先 full term + parenthetical abbreviation，第二次起只用缩写
abstract 内通常不用缩写（除非通用如 DNA, RNA, CRISPR）；intro 之后可广泛使用
figure caption 第一句 = 概括整图核心信息（"Fig. 1 | Title-case headline of what is shown"）
caption 内嵌 panel labels (a, b, c) 对应图中标注；每个 panel 一句说明
caption 末尾含 statistics (n, P, error bar definition) when relevant
avoid "shown in figure" / "see figure" 这类占位表达；caption 自解释
methods 用过去式 + 第三人称/被动（"was measured" / "were collected"），不是 "we measured"
方法描述给可重复细节：仪器型号、软件版本、参数、n、统计方法
统计方法先于结果；P 值给完整（"P = 0.003" not "P < 0.01" if precise）
伦理声明在 methods 末尾：人/动物研究必含 IRB / ethics committee approval
data availability：必有 "Data are available at ... / Data deposition: ... / Source data are provided with this paper."
code availability：custom code 必有 "Custom code is available at ... / Code is deposited at ..."
accession numbers 在 data/code availability 段集中列出，逗号分隔
title 长度 8-15 词，核心发现/对象在前，避免 "Study of ..." "Investigation on ..." "Research on ..."
副标题用冒号或介词短语，主标题是发现，副标题是对象/限定
疑问句标题慎用，多用陈述句；Nature 接受 "How does X?" 但 Cell 偏好陈述
黑名单（永远不在 Nature 用）："obviously / clearly / undoubtedly / it goes without saying / needless to say"
黑名单：避免 "very / extremely / highly" 等强化副词过度使用；用具体度量替代
黑名单：避免 "novel" 反复用（一篇文章最多 1 次，多用 "previously uncharacterized"）
黑名单：避免 "in this paper we" / "in this study we" / "the authors"
黑名单：避免 "It is important to note that" / "It should be noted that" / "It is worth mentioning that"
黑名单：避免 "we believe that" / "in our opinion" / "we think that"
黑名单：避免 "due to the fact that" / "in spite of the fact that" / "owing to the fact that"
黑名单：避免 "a large number of" / "the majority of" / "a great deal of"
黑名单：避免 "in order to"；用 "to"
黑名单：避免 "we delve into" / "we navigate the complexities of" / "the intricate landscape of"
黑名单：避免 "in today's world" / "in the modern era" / "in contemporary society"
黑名单：避免 "plays a crucial role" / "plays a pivotal role" / "is of paramount importance"
黑名单：避免 "cutting-edge" / "state-of-the-art" / "groundbreaking" / "revolutionary"
黑名单：避免 "shed light on" / "shed new light on" / "illuminate" (overused)
黑名单：避免 "fascinating" / "remarkable" / "stunning" / "surprising" (情感形容词)
黑名单：避免 "leverage" (用作动词) / "robust" (用作通用形容)
黑名单：避免 "dive into" / "explore the realm of" / "unpack the nuances"
黑名单：避免 "harness the power of" / "tapestry of" / "symphony of"
